title: Coast Guard rescues boater who was adrift over 13 hours west of Clearwater Beach
description: Seen here is rescue and tow video taken Monday, March 6, 2017 aboard an HC-130 Hercules airplane from Air Station Clearwater and aboard a 45-foot Response Boat - Medium from Station Sand Key during a rescue of a boater 18 miles west of Clearwater Beach. U.S. Coast Guard video.
